method.digests: Read all 23 complete authored digest bodies, intros and historical notes, plus changed paragraphs against the baseline. Paper IDs/notes/frontmatter except summary, all headings/order/derived anchors and source URLs independently checked. Shared paper cards derive from the separately reviewed paper reports; this review does not claim a second full primary-source audit of all card papers.
method.historicalAuditPages: Read both 2026-05-12 audit bodies, verify exact bytes and visibility=audit; their superseded scientific claims remain historical artifacts, not newly endorsed conclusions.
method.otherRecords: Read templates fully; read every changed JSON string with its containing object and relevant rendered source context; inspect source labels, unchanged renderers and email welcome functions. Compare all untouched schema, IDs, dates, routes, candidate/review records and transport code.
method.sourceChecks: Reopened CaAD §4.1/C.1 and Real-Time Evaluation §V where protocol/runtime claims were questionable; no blanket claim that preserving numbers alone validates science.
method.validation: All digest derived headings/anchors unchanged; historical reliability sections, notes and digest/Idea audit files unchanged; node --check scripts/email-publish.mjs passes; email code outside two welcome functions is byte-identical. Browser/rendered-layout and complete regression validation remain the main agent verification scope.
